notes.title: 【Summer Update】Thank you for waiting! The Laboratory map has been added!
notes.content:
You can access the Laboratory map by entering the capsule placed in the Medieval map.ːlunar2019coolpigː
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597776/f032def620a5ff7beeb16f189fcd2e21b2928c0b.png"]

The Laboratory is dimly lit, so make sure to pick up a flashlight!ː2016roastedː

And be careful with the switches and cardboard boxes!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597776/30bacc15caa8fb37c87ece8f6912e07fa77c33d6.png"]

Good luck out there!ːsummer2019hareː

notes.title: [Coming Soon] New Map! Summer Update!
notes.content:
A brand-new laboratory map will be released soon!
And yes, it will be a free update!

All that's left is final testing and adjustments.

With the addition of the laboratory map, players will be able to choose between the Medieval Tower and the Laboratory Map from the beginning.
Dark Tower will remain locked until the Medieval Tower is cleared.

Since all the work is being done by a solo developer, I kindly ask for your patience.

Thank you so much to everyone who has purchased the game — I truly appreciate your support.
